nurturing.name: Nurturing
nurturing.blurb: Raises children with patience and warmth.

neglectful.name: Neglectful
neglectful.blurb: Too busy cultivating to remember names.

ruthless.name: Ruthless
ruthless.blurb: Children are blades to be tempered — or broken.

TRAUMA_PATH_TEXT.never_again: Scarred by the Tournament of Heirs, {head} swore no child of theirs would ever bleed for a seat.
TRAUMA_PATH_TEXT.cycle: The Tournament of Heirs never left {head}. What was done to them, they did in turn.

younger.name: A Younger Child of the Main Line

rival.name: A Child of a Rival House

CHRONICLE_ACCESSION.chosen: Year {year}: {head}, named heir by the one who came before, takes the head seat of the {clan} clan.
CHRONICLE_ACCESSION.tournament: Year {year}: {head}, who walked out of the Tournament of Heirs alone, takes the head seat of the {clan} clan.
CHRONICLE_ACCESSION.clan: Year {year}: the elders of the {clan} clan raise {head} to the head seat.
CHRONICLE_ACCESSION.regency: Year {year}: {head} is still a child. The elders rule in their name until they come of age.
CHRONICLE_ACCESSION.continued: Year {year}: {head} keeps the head seat of the {clan} clan.

CHRONICLE_STYLE.nurturing: The courtyards fill with children’s laughter. {head} rules gently, and raises their children the same way.
CHRONICLE_STYLE.strict: {head} runs the clan like a training ground — dawn drills, silent meals, no excuses.
CHRONICLE_STYLE.neglectful: {head} vanishes into seclusion for decades at a time. The children raise themselves.
CHRONICLE_STYLE.ruthless: {head} rules by fear. The weak are sent away; the strong learn to watch their backs.

CHRONICLE_SECT.grow: The {sect} flourishes under {head}. A new hall rises on the mountain.
CHRONICLE_SECT.hold: The {sect} holds steady — no glory, no ruin.
CHRONICLE_SECT.decline: The {sect} dwindles. Disciples drift away; a hall falls silent.
CHRONICLE_SECT.lost: The {sect} is lost — the {enemy} take the mountain gate, and the clan’s banner comes down.

nurturing: In a famine year, {head} opens the clan granaries to the valley.
A wandering sword saint stays a season, charmed by the clan’s hospitality.
strict: A disciple who failed a trial three times is sent home in disgrace.
The clan’s young win every seat at the regional contest. No one smiles.
neglectful: A cousin forges the head’s seal for years before anyone notices.
Two branches quarrel over an orchard; the head never answers their letters.
ruthless: A cousin who questioned the head is exiled beyond the northern pass.
A rival family that insulted the clan is never heard from again.

CHRONICLE_EXTINCT: Year {year}: no one is left to take the head seat. The {clan} clan’s hall stands empty, and the name passes into history.
CHRONICLE_ORPHAN_DEATH: Year {year}: no clan mourns you. The wind takes your ashes wherever it likes.

CHRONICLE_BIRTH.eldest: Year {year}: the eldest child of {head} awakens their spiritual root.
CHRONICLE_BIRTH.younger: Year {year}: a younger child of {head} awakens their spiritual root.
CHRONICLE_BIRTH.branch: Year {year}: in the {line}, a child awakens their spiritual root.
CHRONICLE_BIRTH.rival: Year {year}: in the house of the {clan}, a child awakens their spiritual root — the house of {enemy}, whom you once knew too well. No one knows. You don’t remember.
CHRONICLE_BIRTH.orphan: Year {year}: somewhere on the road, a child with no name and no clan awakens their spiritual root.

nurturing.title: The Lantern Festival
nurturing.text: {head} takes the children to the lantern festival and lets you choose the first lantern.

choices.label: Wish for the clan
choices.result: {head} squeezes your shoulder.

choices.label: Wish to surpass {head}
choices.result: {head} laughs — and does not forget.

choices.label: Sneak off to cultivate
choices.result: You meditate alone under the lanterns.

nurturing.title: A Fever
nurturing.text: You fall ill with a spirit fever. {head} sits by your bed for three nights.

choices.label: Thank them
choices.result: You will remember those three nights.

choices.label: Send them away — you are fine
choices.result: Proud, and alone, and fine.

strict.title: The Dawn Drill
strict.text: {head} makes the children hold horse stance from dawn to noon. You are the last one standing — or nearly.

choices.label: Hold until you collapse
choices.result: {head} nods once. From {head}, that is a speech.

choices.label: Fake a faint
choices.result: Nobody is fooled. Everyone is punished.

strict.title: The Clan Examination
strict.text: {head} examines every child on the clan scriptures. You forgot to study.

choices.label: Confess
choices.result: Twenty strokes, and a strange respect.

choices.label: Bluff through it
choices.result: You pass. {head} knows. {head} says nothing.

choices.label: Copy a cousin
choices.result: The cousin is punished instead. You keep quiet.

neglectful.title: A Forgotten Birthday
neglectful.text: It is your birthday. {head} is in seclusion again. A servant brings you a steamed bun.

choices.label: Eat the bun and train
choices.result: You do not need anyone. You tell yourself that.

choices.label: Knock on the seclusion door
choices.result: The door opens a crack. {head} looks at you like a stranger — then remembers.

choices.label: Share the bun with the servant
choices.result: The servant weeps. You have a friend in the kitchens now.

neglectful.title: The Locked Library
neglectful.text: Nobody is watching. The head’s private library is unlocked.

choices.label: Read everything
choices.result: You learn more in a month than in the last year.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: Some doors are better left closed.

ruthless.title: Blood in the Courtyard
ruthless.text: {head} makes the children spar with live blades. Your cousin is on the ground, begging.

choices.label: Spare them
choices.result: {head} calls you soft in front of everyone.

choices.label: Finish it as {head} wants
choices.result: {head} smiles for the first time you can remember.

choices.label: Throw down your blade
choices.result: {head} strikes you instead. You do not fall.

ruthless.title: The Winter Trial
ruthless.text: {head} leaves the children on a frozen peak with one cloak between three of you.

choices.label: Share the cloak
choices.result: All three of you come down alive. {head} looks disappointed.

choices.label: Take the cloak
choices.result: You come down first. You do not look back.
